operators.name: Ace
operators.ability: Håvard "Ace" Haugland, is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation Steel Wave expansion alongside Melusi.
operators.quote: There is no chasm too wide, no wall too thick, that will stop me from bringing you home.

operators.name: Alibi
operators.ability: A Light Health Operator, Alibi carries three Prismas, special devices that project volumetric displays of herself. If an enemy were to interfere with the program, they will activate a tracking feature that will cause the victim to be detected for a short while.
operators.quote: Illusions are fatal. If you waver, you're mine. If you pick wrong, you're mine.

operators.name: Amaru
operators.ability: Amaru is a 2-Health, 2-Speed Attacking Operator, and her unique gadget is the Garra Hook launcher, which resembles a harpoon gun.
operators.quote: Forget who you are, and nothing else matters. You’ll fight for anyone, and never know why.

operators.name: Aruni
operators.ability: Apha "Aruni" Tawanroong (Thai: อาภา ตะวันรุ่ง), is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation Neon Dawn expansion.
operators.quote: My gate stands like a star in the darkness, a burning light that keeps enemies at bay. Can you take the heat?

operators.name: Ash
operators.role: Soft breach, Disable, Flank, Entry Fragger
operators.ability: Eliza "Ash" Cohen (Hebrew: אלייזה כהן) is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege and Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mobile.
operators.quote: When I was little, my savta taught me that 'Silence was a woman's best garment'. But, I have to admit, I never really took her advice to heart.

operators.name: Azami
operators.ability: Kana "Azami" Fujiwara (Japanese: 藤原加奈, Fujiwara Kana) is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Demon Veil expansion.
operators.quote: Honor is not the only thing worth protecting... but sometimes it's all you have left.

operators.name: Bandit
operators.ability: Dominic "Bandit" Brunsmeier is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege and Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mobile.
operators.quote: I used to be undercover. I did time. I had to deal drugs. I even had to kill. And I was so good at it that, it got me a promotion.

operators.name: Blackbeard
operators.ability: Blackbeard is a 1-Speed, 3 Health Operator, equipped with the Hybrid Utility Lightweight Layered Adaptable Shield, or H.U.L.L. for short. It is a ballistic shield, made up of four segmented panels. The three body panels are made of a titanium alloy blend, and the last is a transparent polycarbonate which allows Blackbeard to observe his surroundings.
operators.quote: When I enlisted, I was told what was expected of me. Be unwavering. Unstoppable. Unbreakable. It's about time the gear matches the operator.

operators.name: Blitz
operators.ability: Blitz is a 2-Speed, 2-Health Attacking Operator, and his special gadget is the G-52 Tactical Shield.
operators.quote: I don't like photos of myself. The lighting is always wrong.

operators.name: Brava
operators.ability: Nayara "Brava" Cardoso, is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: Sometimes the only path to justice is through a bullet…

operators.name: Buck
operators.ability: Sebastien "Buck" Côté is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: Remember, we are the hunters, they are the prey.

operators.name: Capitão
operators.ability: Vicente "Capitão" Souza is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation Skull Rain expansion alongside Caveira.
operators.quote: Focusing only on the bad things in life will keep you from seeing the many opportunities to do good.

operators.name: Castle
operators.ability: Miles Campbell, codenamed Castle, is a defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege
operators.quote: Listen people: No one dies today. Any questions'll just have to wait.

operators.name: Caveira
operators.ability: Taina "Caveira" Pereira is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation Skull Rain expansion alongside Capitão.
operators.quote: Not every child gets to choose who they grow up to be.

operators.name: Clash
operators.ability: A Heavy Armored Operator, Clash comes equipped with a special Crowd Control Electro Shield. When in use, it fully extends to cover her front-side. The Shield also has a taser function that can slow down enemies in front of her, preventing incoming rushes from Attackers.
operators.quote: Change will come if you’re willing to fight for it.

operators.name: Deimos
operators.ability: Gerald Morris, also known by his alias "Deimos", is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation Deadly Omen expansion.
operators.quote: There's no hiding. Not for you, not for me. Try not to disappoint me, soldier.

operators.name: Doc
operators.ability: Doc is a 3-Health, 1-Speed Defending Operator, and his unique gadget is the MPD-0 Stim Pistol. It is a handheld air pistol which shoots syringes filled with doses of epinephrine.
operators.quote: I've learned from experience that the place to save lives is in the field, not an office. And sometimes the only way to save a life, is to take one.

operators.name: Dokkaebi
operators.ability: Dokkaebi is a 1-Health, 3-Speed Atacking Operator, equipped with the Jegeo (Hangeul: 제거, elimination) Payload.
operators.quote: Your phone is ringing. Here, let me get that for you.

operators.name: Echo
operators.ability: A Medium Health Operator, Echo's unique gadgets are three hovering drones called Yokai, which can stick to flat surfaces on a ceiling, as well as emit ultrasonic bursts that can disorient the enemy.
operators.quote: Don't ask me what I'm doing on my phone. You don't want to know.

operators.name: Ela
operators.ability: Elżbieta "Ela" Bosak is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation Blood Orchid expansion alongside Ying and Lesion.
operators.quote: It's a brutal, dangerous world out there, but I've found my way. Chaos is my home, and I'll make sure you never escape it.

operators.name: Fenrir
operators.ability: Emil "Fenrir" Svensson is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: Fear clouds the mind. You can try to fight it, but you will not survive this.

operators.name: Finka
operators.ability: A Medium Health Operator, Finka comes equipped with her specially-designed nanobots. Having them injected into each of her teammates prior to each mission, her Adrenal Surge allows affected allies to gain a permanent boost in health, on top of other small benefits.
operators.quote: Being afraid of a disease is sometimes worse than the disease itself. There is no cure for fear, so either you surrender to it or you fight it until one of you wins.

operators.name: Flores
operators.role: Soft Breach, Disable, Area Denial, Back Line
operators.ability: Santiago "Flores" Lucero, is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Crimson Heist expansion.
operators.quote: Getting the job done often requires a creative approach. That's where I come in.

operators.name: Frost
operators.ability: Tina Lin "Frost" Tsang is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: There are two things the human body needs in a survival situation: water and hope.

operators.name: Fuze
operators.ability: Fuze is a 3-Health, 1-Speed Attacking Operator, and his unique gadget is the APM-6 Cluster Charge, also known as the "Matryoshka". The device contains a boring mechanism which can drill through most structures, barricades, and terrain. When activated, the Cluster Charge deploys five small fragmentation grenades into the area, which will damage or destroy anything and anyone caught in their blast radii.
operators.quote: Chaos is only an enemy if you're unable to adapt.

operators.name: Glaz
operators.ability: Timur "Glaz" Glazkov (Russian: Тимур Глазков) is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege and Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mobile.
operators.quote: Do you know what an artist and a sniper have in common? Details. Like when a touch of color is out of place. When a shadow does not match with its surroundings. Or when a shape is not where it is supp

operators.name: Goyo
operators.ability: César Ruiz Hernández, codenamed Goyo, is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: A person is never more honest than when they think they're alone.

operators.name: Gridlock
operators.ability: Gridlock is a 1 speed and 3 armor operator armed with the Trax Stinger gadget.
operators.quote: You've gotta have a couple of roos loose in the top paddock to sign up for this life, but there's nowhere I'd rather be.

operators.name: Hibana
operators.ability: Yumiko Imagawa (Japanese: 今川 由美子, Imagawa Yumiko), codenamed Hibana, is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: Kyūdō is meditation in action. Explosions are part of that action.

operators.name: Iana
operators.ability: A Medium Health Operator, Iana's unique gadget is the Gemini Replicator. When activated, it creates a holographic decoy of Iana, which she can control remotely like a drone. It allows Iana to scout ahead and spot traps without setting them off, and can also trick Defenders into exposing themselves or acting prematurely.
operators.quote: All systems are complementary, if you know how to connect them.

operators.name: IQ
operators.ability: IQ is a 1-Health, 3-Speed Attacking Operator, and her gadget is the RED Mk III Electronics Detector, also known as the "Spectre". The device consists of a sensor the size of a mobile phone, mounted on IQ's left wrist.
operators.quote: Life is the ultimate Rube Goldberg machine.

operators.name: Jackal
operators.ability: A Medium Health Operator, Jackal's unique gadget is the Eyenox Model III, which can track enemy footprints and can identify its targets.
operators.quote: You can't escape me, but that doesn’t mean you won't try.

operators.name: Jäger
operators.ability: Marius "Jäger" Streicher (pronounced Yeh-ger) is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege and Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mobile.
operators.quote: They said it could not be done. They said it was designed for tanks. They said I could not make it smaller and more accurate. They were wrong.

operators.name: Kaid
operators.ability: A Heavy Armored Operator, Kaid is equipped with two throwable "Rtila" Electroclaws that can be thrown onto any surface it can attach to, electrifying metal objects within a certain radius of the gadget.
operators.quote: Lead by example and the mountain will move.

operators.name: Kali
operators.ability: A Medium Health Operator, Kali is equipped with the CSRX 300 rifle, a powerful bolt-action sniper rifle which can pierce through multiple breakable walls, and destroy wooden barricades within a single shot. It can down an enemy with one shot to the chest or can kill them instantly with a headshot. The CSRX 300 comes equipped with interchangable sights that are labled 5x and 12x in-game.
operators.quote: Acceptance of mediocrity is the first step toward failure.

operators.name: Kapkan
operators.ability: Maxim "Kapkan" Basuda (Russian: Максим Басуда) is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege and Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mobile.
operators.quote: These soldiers think their training will keep them alive. They break down doors and come through windows, weapons drawn. They check the corners, watch each other's backs, and give the all clear. But i

operators.name: Lesion
operators.ability: Liu Tze Long (Chinese: 廖子朗), codenamed Lesion, is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation Blood Orchid expansion alongside Ying and Ela.
operators.quote: Do what you do best. If you're lucky, you won't be a burden.

operators.name: Lion
operators.ability: Olivier "Lion" Flament is an Attacking Operator in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: People died, and I hope I can find forgiveness for it, but what I did I did to save more lives. I’d do it again. That’s doing my job.

operators.name: Maestro
operators.ability: Adriano "Maestro" Martello is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: Did I ever tell you about the time we tree-jumped into the Congo Swamp at night? No? Oh, it's a good one.

operators.name: Maverick
operators.ability: A light health Operator, Maverick comes equipped with his Exothermic-S "Suri" Torch. It can make holes in any breachable surface, including Reinforced Walls, creating new lines of sight quietly.
operators.quote: I was trapped, for a long time. Lived and seen things, you couldn't imagine. Now I see things... in a different light.

operators.name: Melusi
operators.ability: Thandiwe "Melusi" Ndlovu, is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation Steel Wave expansion alongside Ace.
operators.quote: Understanding is the only tool that vanquishes ignorance.

operators.name: Mira
operators.ability: Elena María Álvarez, codenamed Mira, is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation Velvet Shell expansion alongside Jackal.
operators.quote: Think of me as your conscience. I see everything, and I'm just as ruthless.

operators.name: Montagne
operators.ability: Montagne is a 3-Health, 1-Speed Attacking Operator, and his unique ability is the Extendable Shield, also known as "Le Roc".
operators.quote: Every conflict is an iteration upon the last. Every scar, a victory.

operators.name: Mozzie
operators.ability: Max Goose, codenamed Mozzie, is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: Some say I'm a pest. I say right back atcha, mate!

operators.name: Mute
operators.ability: Chandar, codenamed Mute, is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege and Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mobile.
operators.quote: People think my codename is Mute because I don't like to talk. Maybe I just don't like you.

operators.name: Nomad
operators.ability: A Medium Health Operator, Nomad is equipped with an Airjab launcher which can shoot out up to three "Airjab" repulsion grenades that will stick to any surface she shoots at and knock down all in its effective radius when triggered.
operators.quote: Deep down in my veins, I knew I had to travel. Now that I have, I’m certain I haven’t traveled enough.

operators.name: Nøkk
operators.ability: Karina Gaarddhøje, codenamed Nøkk, is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation Phantom Sight expansion alongside Warden.
operators.quote: The only thing I feel when I pull the trigger is recoil.

operators.name: Oryx
operators.ability: A Medium Armored Operator, Oryx's unique ability is the Remah Dash. When activated, he performs a quick dash, making him move faster than any other Defender for a short period of time. While dashing, Oryx can smash through Barricades unreinforced walls, Osa shields and Deployable Shields, and can knock down any Attackers he dashes into, including shield bearers such as Montagne, Blitz and Fuze.
operators.quote: Sometimes, the only way out is through.

operators.name: Osa
operators.role: Intel Gatherer, Area Denial, Anti Roam
operators.ability: Anja Katarina "Osa" Janković, is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Crystal Guard expansion.
operators.quote: My work keeps us one step ahead. The best that money can buy. Our agents may have their skill sets, but my designs? They give us the edge in the field. So that we can hit hard, and come back safe. Not

operators.name: Pulse
operators.ability: Jack "Pulse" Estrada is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: In a life threatening situation, the average person's heartbeat can be upwards of 175 beats per minute. A well trained tango is able to stay cool, keep calm. Their heart rates can be 70 to 100 beats p

operators.name: Ram
operators.ability: Choi Bo-ram (Hangeul: 최보람, Choe Bo Lam) codenamed Ram, is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: If we're coming for you, run. We don't stop for anything, or anyone. We are the danger from above.

operators.name: Rauora
operators.ability: Hāpai "Rauora" Iwini is an attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation Prep Phase expansion. She had previously appeared in the comic story for Operation Collision Point under the nickname "Striker Z09", where she helps Blackbeard save Sens' life from a squad of Keres Soldiers during the Assault on Hereford.
operators.quote: With fires and firefights, controlling the environment is a must. And sometimes that means waiting for the right door to open. But I've never been a patient sort. So mine will be ready when I need it

operators.name: Rook
operators.ability: Julien "Rook" Nizan is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege and Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mobile.
operators.quote: I trust that the ceramic trauma plate I'm wearing will stop a .357 Magnum round traveling at four-hundred and ninety meters per second. I trust myself not to move, not to flinch. I trust my team mates

operators.name: Sens
operators.ability: Néon Ngoma Mutombo, codenamed Sens, is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: Fighting hostiles is like... solving a puzzle. All the pieces are a total mess. Then, you solve it as if you always knew the answer.

operators.name: Skopós
operators.ability: Skopós' Unique Gadget are the V10 Pantheon Shells, a pair of humanoid robots which she remotely controls and act as her body in the field. The Shells can move, shoot and use gadgets like any other operator, but Skopós can only activate and control one Shell at a time. The other Shell will be inactive, in which it will crouch down and deploy a Bulletproof Shield to protect itself, and act as a remote camera. Skopós can switch control from one Shell to the other at any time, allowing her to quickly
operators.quote: I was an apex killer, fueled by instinct and adrenaline. Times change though, and so have I. Now I'm twice as dangerous.

operators.name: Sledge
operators.ability: Seamus "Sledge" Cowden is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege and Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mobile.
operators.quote: Remember, I take the doors.

operators.name: Smoke
operators.ability: James Porter, codenamed Smoke, is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege and Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mobile.
operators.quote: I know what you're wondering. "What's in the canister?" I could tell ya, but then I'd have to kill you. Hehe. I'm only mucking about, relax. As for what's in the canister, it's best you don't ask.

operators.name: Solis
operators.ability: Ana "Solis" Valentina Díaz is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege introduced in the Operation Solar Raid expansion.
operators.quote: If you know the game before it starts, no pawn can stand in your way.

operators.name: Tachanka
operators.ability: ]] Aleksandr Senav'yev), codenamed Tachanka (Тачанка) (Tachankin in Russian localisation, Тачанкин), is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: They told me I’d died. They were wrong. I was reborn.

operators.name: Thatcher
operators.ability: A heavy Health Operator, Thatcher is equipped with the E.G.S. Disruptor. This device can disable all electronics that are in its line of sight.
operators.quote: GPS satellites? Unmanned drones? Fookin' laser sights? The more crutches you have, the more it hurts when they're kicked out from under ya. If there's one thing I know for sure, it's that a six inch b

operators.name: Thermite
operators.ability: Jordan Trace, codenamed Thermite, is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege and Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mobile.
operators.quote: When you mix fuel, metal oxide and metal powder in just the right way, it burns at 2000 degrees Celsius. Hot enough to cut through nearly any barrier known to man. Throw some C4 into the mix, and you'

operators.name: Thorn
operators.ability: Thorn's Unique Gadget is the Razorbloom Shell, a proximity grenade that can be thrown and attached to any surface. When deployed, any Attacker that enters its radius will start the Razorbloom's timer, followed by a powerful explosion a short moment later. Additionally, any operator who gets hit but survives the explosion will get a limping debuff for 10s, making them unable to sprint.
operators.quote: You know, having four gobshite brothers taught me a valuable lesson. Don't waste your energy on the first three.

operators.name: Thunderbird
operators.ability: Mina "Thunderbird" Sky is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the North Star expansion.
operators.quote: Preparation, speed, precision. These are essential when it comes to saving lives. And that's how I fly.

operators.name: Tubarão
operators.ability: |Tubarão}}Isaac "Tubarão" Nunes Oliveira is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: In combat, every second counts, and time waits for no one. Unless... you can slow things down.

operators.name: Twitch
operators.ability: Emmanuelle Pichon, codenamed Twitch, is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege and Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mobile.
operators.quote: If you have a few spare hours, I'd love to share the details of how this device is a masterpiece of design. Quadruple independent gear boxes enabling zero to twenty in under four seconds, ten kilomete

operators.name: Valkyrie
operators.ability: "Valkyrie" Castellano is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation Dust Line expansion alongside Blackbeard.
operators.quote: If you don't constantly feel like you're being watched, then you aren't paying attention.

operators.name: Vigil
operators.ability: Hwa Chul-kyung (Hangeul: 화철경, Hwa Cheol Gyeong), codenamed Vigil is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation White Noise expansion introduced alongside Zofia and Dokkaebi.
operators.quote: You never saw me coming. Don't feel so bad. Nobody ever sees me. I'm in everyone's blind spot.

operators.name: Wamai
operators.ability: Ngũgĩ Muchoki Furaha, codenamed Wamai, is a Defending Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege.
operators.quote: The closer you are to death, the more vibrant life becomes.

operators.name: Warden
operators.ability: A Medium Health Operator, Warden's unique gadget is a pair of Glance Smart Glasses, special glasses that nullify the effects of Stun Grenades, Smoke Grenades, and other related gadgets.
operators.realname:
Collinn McKinley
|organization \ Secret Service Rainbow (formerly) Ghosteyes (fo
operators.quote: I won't leave you behind, not now, not ever.

operators.name: Ying
operators.ability: Siu Mei Lin (Chinese: 蕭美蓮), codenamed Ying, is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation Blood Orchid expansion alongside Lesion and Ela.
operators.quote: The punch starts from the heart and does not miss.

operators.name: Zero
operators.ability: A Medium Health Operator, Zero's gadget is the ARGUS Launcher, which launches small cameras. These cameras can burrow into any surface, including reinforced walls and hatches, and provide a camera view on both sides of the deployed surface.
operators.quote: You should know better than to write me off. Consider this a teaching moment.

operators.name: Zofia
operators.ability: Zofia Bosak is an Attacking Operator featured in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, introduced in the Operation White Noise expansion alongside Dokkaebi and Vigil.
operators.quote: I decide when to restrain and when to kill. Only the best calls the shots.
